label: Auto-Calibration
notes: Open by framing the goal: we already have a projective reconstruction that reprojects perfectly, yet its metric geometry is wrong. Auto-calibration uses only constraints on the cameras' internal parameters to pin down the plane at infinity and the absolute conic, with no calibration target in the scene.

label: The Stratified Picture
notes: Explain the three strata. Projective structure is known up to a fifteen-parameter homography, affine structure fixes the plane at infinity, and metric structure fixes the absolute conic on that plane. Stress that constancy or known form of the intrinsics is the physical fact that lets us climb the ladder.

label: The Absolute Conic and Its Image
notes: Define the absolute conic as the fixed imaginary conic on the plane at infinity, invariant under similarity transforms. Its image omega equals the inverse of K K transpose, so once omega is found the calibration matrix follows by Cholesky. Emphasize that a moving rigid camera always sees the same absolute conic.

label: The Absolute Dual Quadric
notes: Introduce the dual absolute quadric as the single four by four rank-three object that packages both unknowns. Its null vector is the plane at infinity and its non-trivial part is the absolute conic. This is the fixed object every auto-calibration method solves for; everything else is bookkeeping around it.

label: The Projection Equation
notes: Derive the central identity: a camera projects the dual quadric to the dual image of the absolute conic, P times Q-star times P transpose proportional to K K transpose. Make clear this single equation turns assumptions about the internals into constraints on one shared 3D quadric across all views.

label: Recovering the Rectifying Homography
notes: Show how the recovered quadric yields the upgrade. Eigendecompose Q-star to read off the calibration block and the plane at infinity, assemble the four by four rectifying homography, and apply it to every camera and point. Note the residual scale and sign care needed when forming H from the factorization.

label: Linear Self-Calibration
notes: Work the varying-focal-length special case. Known principal point, zero skew, and unit aspect ratio make the projected dual conic diagonal, giving four linear rows per view on the ten entries of Q-star. The stacked system's nullspace recovers the quadric; the focal lengths drop out per view.

label: The Kruppa Equations
notes: Present Kruppa as the two-view route that needs only fundamental matrices, no explicit reconstruction. The epipole-bracketed dual conic must be proportional to F omega-star F transpose. Warn that Kruppa is weaker than a known infinite homography and does not enforce full multiview quadric consistency.

label: Kruppa as Epipolar Tangency
notes: Give the geometric intuition behind Kruppa: epipolar planes tangent to the absolute conic induce corresponding tangent epipolar lines in both images. Walk through the tangent-line picture with an ordinary visible conic, then connect tangency, a dual-conic notion, to why the algebra is written with omega-star.

label: Stratified Upgrade via the Infinite Homography
notes: Once the plane at infinity is known the affine-to-metric step is linear. The infinite homography H-infinity equals A minus a p transpose, and it transfers the image of the absolute conic between views. A rotating camera's inter-image homography is already an infinite homography, so the same equation calibrates it.

label: Critical Motions and Degeneracy
notes: Drive home the practical warning. Auto-calibration fails when motion is too restricted: a single rotation axis, planar rig motion, pure translation, or turntable sequences leave unobservable directions. Show these as extra nullity in the constraint spectrum, and recommend checking conditioning before trusting any recovered calibration.

label: Synthesis
notes: Close by tying the strands together. Auto-calibration is a metric upgrade: find the plane at infinity and the absolute conic, or package both in the dual quadric. The projection identity converts internal-parameter assumptions into constraints; degeneracy shows up as extra nullity, and bundle adjustment refines the final result.
